nom: The Ordinary Matrixyl 10% + Hyaluronic Acid for Fine Lines and Wrinkles

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results, ranging from new breakouts or a parched, tight feeling by afternoon in dry or air-conditioned climates to well-held moisture over months with no breakouts or redness.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no stinging or irritation, describing comfortable daily use even when layered with other actives.
segments.mature: Reviewers over roughly 45, who make up a large share of the reviews, most often describe firmer, plumper skin with softened fine lines within two weeks to a few months of daily use, though one reviewer past 65 saw no noticeable difference after a year.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers who used this for wrinkles and fine lines report visible softening and increased firmness, commonly on the forehead, neck, and jawline, within two weeks to a few months of daily use, especially when layered with Argireline Solution; several others report no noticeable change even after a month or two of consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum as hydrating and plumping, including one who pairs it with an occlusive overnight in a dry climate with good results; one reviewer in a different dry, air-conditioned climate instead found the hyaluronic acid pulled moisture from her skin, leaving it feeling parched by mid-afternoon.
concerns.redness: Only one reviewer speaks directly to redness, reporting none after regular daily and nightly use in a dry climate, alongside no breakouts or clogged pores.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer combining this with tretinoin says it noticeably reduced the dryness, flaking, and sensitivity caused by the retinoid, describing a marked improvement within a week of adding it to that routine.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers who mention pigmentation or uneven skin tone among their concerns say it improved alongside their overall routine, though neither isolates the result from the other products used at the same time.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report new breakouts, cystic pimples, or clogged pores after starting the product, in some cases the day after first use; others, including long-term daily users, report no breakouts and describe their skin as clear or blemish-free.

aspects.libelle: Sticky, tacky texture that can pill
Layers easily within a multi-step routine
Unclear guidance on combining with other actives

extraits.titre: I have used it before but now I am breaking out!
extraits.texte: I think ordinary changed something in the formula for couple of their product. I got acne all over my face with using their serums. I am trying to return them but I have not heard back from them. So the problem started exactly the day after I add them to my routine. Nothing else is new and I have not used them all at once. I never add everything that I bought all together. I tried them one by one and couple of days in between. This was suppose to be a replacement for the pricy Vichy HA serum so I can use that less than every day.
I am 50 and have dry skin. I used this 2 days in a row and now have 17 pimples on my face. This is the inky oart of my routine i changed.

extraits.titre: Wish this was available without HA
extraits.texte: I love the ingredients and have been using this product for the past few years and saw improvements fairly quickly. I live in a very Phoenix, and it is really dry here. Not only is the climate dry, the air conditioning also dries out the indoor air. HA doesn't work in a dry climate and can actually pull the moisture from your skin. so a few hours into the day, my skins feels parched. HA is all the rage now, but it isn't appropriate for everyone. I still use this product but have to go through several steps to try to minimize the HA effect. I would urge the ordinary to consider making a formula without the HA for those of us in dry climates.
Bought this to help treat wrinkles and this product has been great. It goes on smoothly and doesn't sting or bother my sensitive skin

extraits.titre: Working great for my 58yr old skin
extraits.texte: I started using Matrixyl in Jan 2024 in AM only, so just over 4mths in. I love what it's doing for my skin, so far. It's a lovely light serum that works great with my moisturizer, sunscreen and makeup. I use niacinamide & retinal.02% at night (having stepped up slowly with lower retinoids) and the combination has really started giving results. I've recently had 3 totally random comments about how good my complexion looks (I've never had happen before)! I'm fair skinned with freckles and over the years gained sun damage, pigmentation, wrinkles, enlarged pores, breakouts and more! All of these latter issues are definitely improving - I wish I'd started this skincare regime years ago! I love The Ordinary products and im so glad I started using them.

extraits.titre: Works well, but takes a lot of time
extraits.texte: I'm 28, I have dry sensitive skin, and rather pronounced dynamic lines on my forehead. The lines were there since I was a teen, just a skin feature of active facial expressions I guess. In the last couple of (very stressful) years these lines got deeper and longer, across all my forehead. I tried multiple products and this one is the best so far. It took a couple of months until I noticed the results. My lines smoothened out, not completely of course, but they are far less noticeable. Strange enough it didn't seem to affect my smile lines or area around the eye so much. However, once I'm out of this product, it seems like the lines are coming back, so I will keep using this for now. With TO it's hit or miss for me, multipeptide serum breaks me out very quick, and argireline did nothing, so one just has to find the product that matches ones' skin.

I live in a desert climate and am always looking for ways to hydrate my thirsty skin. I stay away from hyaluronic acid because there's no moisture in the air to pull from but feel like most deeply hydrating products contain it. I got this after reading the reviews and already can't imagine my routine without it. I use it with the retinol, rose hip oil, and squalene in rotation and my skin looks and feels so much better in the mornings. It's not greasy at all and absorbs very quickly. I use it AM and PM and haven't had any negative reaction at all. No breakouts, no clogged pores, no redness. Love it!
